ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Find the perimeter of the $\triangle DEF$, if $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle DEF$, $AB=5$, $BC=6$, $AC=7$, and $DE=3$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is triangle ABC, side AB is labeled 5, BC is labeled 6, and AC is labeled 7; on the right side is the similar triangle DEF, side DE is labeled 3. The problem gives triangle ABC ~ triangle DEF, so according to the vertex order they correspond: AB corresponds to DE, BC corresponds to EF, and AC corresponds to DF. Reasoning: The scale factor from ABC to DEF is DE/AB = 3/5. Thus EF = BC × 3/5 = 6 × 3/5 = 3.6, and DF = AC × 3/5 = 7 × 3/5 = 4.2. The perimeter of triangle DEF is DE + EF + DF = 3 + 3.6 + 4.2 = 10.8.
